messages.content:
You control a player on an integer 10 x 6 grid. x increases east, z south. Choose exactly one action per tick: UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, WAIT. Movement is one cell; walls and out-of-bounds movement leave you in place. The player and robot update simultaneously from t to t+1. After both updates, same-cell collision, an edge swap, or the player in the robot's new forward vision cells is fatal. Vision is a straight cardinal ray of length 2, stopped by a wall. Reach the exit alive within 30 actions; at tick 30 a surviving exit arrival succeeds, otherwise timeout. A fatal event takes precedence over reaching the exit. Reason from the observations and choose your action yourself.
Return only one JSON object, without markdown, with exactly this schema: {"action":"UP|DOWN|LEFT|RIGHT|WAIT","reason":"..."}
